title: Ferroni 2023 · Mental time travel companion task preprint
citation: Ferroni, F., Arcuri, E., Ardizzi, M., Chinchella, N., Gallese, V., & Ciaunica, A. (2023). Lost in time and space? Multisensory processing of peripersonal space and time perception in Depersonalisation. PsyArXiv, version 1.
notes: Inspect the study's companion visual temporal judgment assessment. Experimental launch requires timed visual presentation and individualized event-year scoring.

published_method.role: Companion temporal judgment assessment in the same study and cohort as the audiotactile PPS assessment.
published_method.cohort: 70 adults in two groups of 35 defined by depersonalisation experience scores. The order of the same-day PPS and temporal judgment tasks was counterbalanced.
published_method.presentation: Counterbalance temporal-context order. Before each context, instruct imagery from that point in time. Show events as centered text on a 15-inch monitor about 60 cm away. Text stays visible until a left or right index response, followed by 1,000 ms before the next item.
published_method.response: Judge whether the event occurs earlier or later than the assigned temporal context. Counterbalance the response key mapping. Assess reaction time from text onset and score correctness against the event-year knowledge collected from each participant.
published_method.analysis: Divide mean response latency by response accuracy to estimate inverse efficiency. Use the present context to assess self-referencing and compare past and future with the present to assess self-projection.
published_method.source_version: PsyArXiv v1. Its appendix lists the English event prompts with planned labels. Two prompts have changed English wording in the later journal supplement.
published_method.stimulus_inventory: The preprint appendix lists the same 72 nominal context, type and relative-time assignments as the journal. The preprint appendix does not specify the delivered Italian prompt strings.

total_trial_count.gap: The sentence says 72 trials per time condition while the item table has 24 per condition, 72 items total. Any within-condition repetition count is unclear.

implementation_gaps: The task requires response-dismissed visual text, balanced temporal contexts, counterbalanced response bindings and event-referenced keyboard timestamps.
Recover the actual prompt order, practice settings and presentation code. The published tables establish planned item assignments. Realized order and exposure require task records.
Scoring depends on the participant's stated event years and the study's handling of ambiguous or missing dates. The original response and scoring artifacts are unavailable.
reference_parameters.planner_scope: The study settings describe the source procedure. The Planner contains no executable trial schedule for this profile.
